decisions.reason: Its value is proven through government use and over 30 APIS connections, so the uncertainty has resolved in its favour and further commitment is justified rather than abandonment.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health data is still declining and no results have been reported, but the API costs little to run and could fold into travel document checks, so the option stays open for one more year.
Cyber awareness training fits the firm's certified trainer base at low marginal cost, and demand driven by compliance is growing, so keeping it preserves upside while its value is still unresolved.
Behaviour analysis is core to the firm's specialist detection capability and could extend into new sectors, so the option is worth holding even though no results have been reported yet.
The verification platform sits close to the established offer, complements the proven passenger data solution, and is cheap to maintain, so it is kept while its results develop.
